<div id="{{{id|{{lc:{{<includeonly>subst:</includeonly>PAGENAMEE}}}}}}}" class="messagebox noprint darkbackground1" style="border:1px solid {{{border1|#AAA}}}; padding:3px; background:{{{bg1|#EEF}}}">
{| class="transparent-background" style="width:100%; border:1px solid {{{border2|#CCC}}}; border-collapse:collapse; background:{{{bg2|#FFF}}}"
| style="padding:5px; text-align:center" | {{{image|}}}
| style="padding:3px 5px 3px 0px; width:100%; {{{messagestyle|}}}" | {{{message|}}}
|}
</div><noinclude>
__NOTOC__
==Description==
A '''small message box''', generally used as a notice inside the {{Tl|Information}} template on a file page.

==Usage==
<pre>
{{SmallMB
|image=
|message=
}}
</pre>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|image}} The image to include on the left-hand side of the box, such as <code><nowiki>[[File:Information icon.svg|40px]]</nowiki></code>.
*{{Para|message}} The written message on the right-hand side of the box.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|id}} The [[wikipedia:HTML|HTML]] <code>id</code> attribute of the box, which defaults to the template name in lowercase.
*{{Para|border1}} The outer border color, default <code style="padding:0 5px; border:1px solid #AAA; border-radius:3px">#AAA</code>.
*{{Para|border2}} The inner border color, default <code style="padding:0 5px; border:1px solid #CCC">#CCC</code>.
*{{Para|bg1}} The outer background color, default <code style="padding:0 5px; background:#EEF; color:#000">#EEF</code> in light mode.
*{{Para|bg2}} The inner background color, default <code style="padding:0 5px; background:#FFF; color:#000">#FFF</code> in light mode.
*{{Para|messagestyle}} Any additional [[wikipedia:CSS|CSS]] styling for the message text, such as <code><nowiki>text-align:center</nowiki></code>.

[[Category:Utility templates]]</noinclude>
